text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto Daishoten—Cheval Grand put on an 
amazing performance, going toe-to-toe with 
Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after the race, Satono Diamond speaks 
with absolute poise. Knowing she could 
compete against someone so well-grounded 
gives Cheval Grand even more confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, just as they were talking 
about how the Japan Cup against her 
childhood friend was finally up next—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna Hayakawa rushes in with the news 
that Shine Praise suffered a serious 
injury during training in Australia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A severe injury to the ligament—returning 
to racing would require surgery, and in 
the worst-case scenario, she might never 
be able to walk again.
